implementation: Record the actual scenario identity, map, instance, server boot time and entrance when a player successfully enters a native scenario. Save the versioned checkpoint in characters.scenarioResume in the same transaction as ordinary character position; keep current position separate from the entrance.

Read and validate the checkpoint before stale-transport fallback, difficulty selection and map creation. A matching live scenario in the same server run preserves actors, criteria and saved coordinates. A missing/recycled/restarted instance begins at the recorded entrance because scenario actors and criteria are not persisted.

Validate native Scenario/LFG map routing, scenario steps, map type and coordinates. Exclude battlegrounds, Ashran, garrisons and challenge-mode scenarios. Keep remaining map admission, capacity, difficulty, condition and binding checks. Final admission validates the live instance after the constructor has consumed the selector.

Existing New Blood and Scepter bootstrap/quest-item handling remains for old saves, but cannot override a different recorded scenario on a shared map. A normal exit and a completed scenario clear the checkpoint. An explicit character unlock retains priority.
Log original saved map/instance/transport and the exact post-add login rejection before exit/home fallback. These diagnostics must remain visible rather than suppressing failures.

limits: No exact-stage resurrection after restart is claimed: actors, paths, dialogue timers, summons and scenario criteria are not serialized by this change. Generic fresh runs restart at their entrance; content-specific unique items and other quest restart contracts still need their own handlers, as New Blood already has.

New checkpoints apply after a successful entry and character save with this implementation. Old saves without a checkpoint retain existing quest-specific recovery; ambiguous shared maps are not guessed from arbitrary active quests.
A native scenario without matching LFG routing cannot use this generic reconstruction path. Ordinary dungeons, raids, outdoor phased quests and intentional exits are outside its scope.
Tests use fixture map/instance/storage services and do not replace real client relog, server restart, pet, vehicle, camera, collision, visual or full quest interaction checks.
